items.name: Forward order book
items.claim: NEXTDC's forward order book increased 83 per cent to 544MW.

items.name: Pro forma contracted capacity utilisation

notes: Both items sourced from the stored 5 May 2026 funding announcement (data/web/16bc3aba549f0a0e.json). Figures are capacity (MW), not dollar backlog, which is how NEXTDC discloses its data-centre order book.
